description: Social inbox comments and replies for Instagram, Facebook Pages, Threads, and LinkedIn Pages (Pro plan or higher plus posts:read). Without comment_id: list comments filtered by account, platform, unread/flagged, or search, with limit/offset paging. With comment_id: one comment and its replies; only workspace_id may be added.

comment_id.description: One comment (from a list call) with its replies.

limit.description: Number of comments to return. Default 50, max 100.

offset.description: Skip this many comments before returning results.

search.description: Search comment content or author username.

workspace_id.description: Optional. Omit to search every workspace you belong to; pass a workspace ID from whoami to limit to one.

name: list_comments
